items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that came in with My People, but Ray Nance was in there on the violin.

ctx.x: Yeah, that came in with My People, but Ray Nance was in there on the violin. He had a part on his violin and man, he was great. Soul, really a soul man. He would play that violin and get on to one of them notes.
Ray and I went to high school together in Chicago.
